turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me before that zero went in.
I'll stand. I have a call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
I don't recall a phone call. Nobody called me before that zero went in. Who decided on it?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
Flattery isn't evidence, Hale. What do you have on Owen's essay that I can check myself?
